Welcome to Agent School — lesson six.
Yesterday: AI makes things up when it's missing information.
"Write a post about coffee." You'll get something… generic.
Role: you're a barista with twenty years of experience.
Context: it's for my café's Instagram.
Task: one post about our new cold brew.
Format: under fifty words, one emoji, end with a question.
And one bonus trick: show an example of what good looks like.
AI copies patterns better than it follows descriptions.
A vague prompt makes the model guess.
A clear prompt removes the guessing.
